description:
Get a link your principal opens in a browser to subscribe. No API key
    needed. Give them the URL — you cannot complete this yourself, and should
    not try: they sign in, accept the Terms and authenticate the payment.

    If the tier includes API access, their account page then shows a short
    pairing code; read it back into ``rayana_ai_complete_setup`` to get your
    API key without them pasting a secret into this conversation. **Standard
    does not include API or MCP access** — if the point of the purchase is a
    key for you, ask for pro or elite.
name: rayana_ai_start_checkout

outputSchema.description:
What an agent hands its human to subscribe. Deliberately NOT a Stripe
Checkout URL: this link lands on a Rayana page that signs the human in,
takes their assent to the Terms, and only then starts Stripe's own hosted
Checkout. See api/mcp_server.py's `rayana_ai_start_checkout` for why the
indirection is the point rather than an extra hop.
outputSchema.title: CheckoutHandoff
